lines.text: Accept the one whose faith is weak, and neither the eater nor the abstainer may judge the other, for God has accepted him.
One person regards a certain day above the others, another considers every day alike, and each acts to the Lord.
Whether we live or die we belong to the Lord, and we will all stand before Caesar’s judgment seat.
Paul says to stop judging one another, because if your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love.
All food is clean, but it is better not to eat fish or drink wine if your brother stumbles.
